info.title: Tracecart API
info.description: REST API for the Tracecart store, customer accounts, back office, Seller Center and Partner portal. Each operation's x-tracecart-access says who may call it: public, session, account, or a permission.

bearerAuth.description: A Clerk session token for a user linked to a Tracecart account.

days.description: Days until it's handed over (in stock, seller), or until it leaves the supplier (abroad). Not a delivery date: that comes with the delivery promise at checkout.

correctedQuery.description: What was searched instead, when the words as typed found nothing.

phrase.description: The words of the query it was read from.

amountMinor.description: priceMax, priceMin: in minor units of `currency`.

value.description: brand: its slug; condition: REFURBISHED or USED; delivery: local.

removeQuery.description: The query without this phrase, to undo it.

interpreted.description: Filters read from the query's words (a price limit, a brand, a condition, in stock), applied unless the same filter was given as a parameter.

truncated.description: More products matched than are filtered and counted at once; the query should be narrowed.

direction.description: from: this product FITS/CHARGES… the ones listed; to: the ones listed FIT/CHARGE… this product.

permissions.description: Every permission the user's roles give, sorted.

post.summary: Record a shipment milestone that happened (Super Admin of the hub, or the assigned carrier), from payment until delivery (after it, only RETURN_STARTED). A delay or a failed delivery needs a reason; a revised ETA needs the new window. Send an idempotencyKey (or Idempotency-Key header) so a retry records nothing twice — the replay answers 200 instead of 201. The customer is told about the milestones that concern them; a repeated, unchanged delay isn't sent again. Delays, failed deliveries and missing customs documents open an exception.
Open an exception on an order (Super Admin). One open exception per type and order.

Confirm the customer's payment (Super Admin only). Notifies the partner to prepare.

post.summary: Quote a request for its customer: the item price is the agent's; shipping, duties and fees are worked out for the destination (409 QUOTE_UNPRICEABLE with the problems when they can't be). It replaces any open quote; the customer is emailed.

candidateId.description: The listing found for it, marked selected.

title.description: What is sold, as the customer reads it.

categorySlug.description: Its category: customs rates and the default weight come from it.

brand.description: A brand the catalogue knows, by name.

unitPriceMinor.description: The item's price per unit in the store currency, before shipping, duties and fees (the agent's price, margin included).

weightGrams.description: One unit, packed. Defaults to the category's.

destination.description: Where the price takes it; defaults to the request's city, delivered to an address.

post.summary: Promote to catalogue: the quoted product and its cross-border offer go on sale in the store
Search every enabled provider, then normalise, de-duplicate and rank the listings. Unavailable or failing providers are reported, never faked.

put.summary: Replace the product spec with a corrected one (validated like Claude's)

post.summary: Cancel an order not yet shipped: stock goes back, a pending payment is cancelled, a captured one is recorded as a refund due
